content.title: CENTRALIZED MONITORING CONSOLE
content.content:
- **Pipeline execution dashboard**: Real-time view of all pipeline executions across all Ground Plex nodes — status (running/completed/failed/queued), throughput in documents per second, execution duration, error count, queue depth, and scheduled task next-time. Filterable by pipeline, project, time range, and execution status.

- **Node resource monitoring**: Real-time CPU utilisation, memory usage, and I/O per Ground Plex node, updated via 20-second heartbeat. Configurable alert thresholds trigger notifications when resource exhaustion occurs — enabling proactive capacity management rather than reactive incident response.

- **Administrative failure management**: Failed pipelines can be restarted, re-queued, or cancelled directly from the monitoring console or via the REST API. Schedule management (pause, resume, edit, delete) is also available without Designer access — enabling operational teams to manage production pipelines without design-level access.
